comments_data.body: Hi guys! The screenshot looks good but the deployment link sends me to Papafoxtrot.

> Hi guys! The screenshot looks good but the deployment link sends me to Papafoxtrot.

Sure. The issue is there there is only one game visible - so Serge takes us directly into that game.

So, here's how you can get around the issue:
- log into admin
- change `CmdWk-High data` to be visible ("Show wargame" in context menu)
- delete last bit of URL, to go back to Serge home page
- click on "Play"
- Select `CmdWk - High data` game
- log in as Game Control
- click on a platform, to view visibility panel

issues.title: Icon Uniformity Mapping
issues.body:
We present square icons in the asset menu on the mapping page: 

![Stick to Circles Instead of Squares for Logo Uniformity](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/85491794/149668354-66d51fdb-20d8-4041-90ef-937f8960865b.png)

It's the only page to my knowledge where we present square icons. 
We should stick to circular icons to maintain force icon uniformity.

comments.body: Sure. Can we switch to circular icons for force?
